requirements.title: Independent action authorization
requirements.description: Every mutating or side-effecting action retains its categorical authorization gate.

requirements.title: Authority facts and intent remain separate
requirements.description: Mechanical authority facts override semantic intent hints and hints never grant capability.

requirements.title: Codex resource route
requirements.description: Map responsibility-based resource judgments to six host configuration suggestions and actual acceptance, without capability ranking.

requirements.title: Project Bootstrap navigation
requirements.description: Enter navigation3 projects through their fixed Bootstrap and keep original navigation1/2 sources on their original entry.

requirements.title: Sealed tool operation resolution
requirements.description: Resolve exact fixed operations and actual host creation, identity and initial delegation while reusing healthy bindings.

requirements.title: Observed Codex delivery
requirements.description: Map real host acceptance to exact consumer delivery and retain unknown or rejected outcomes.

requirements.title: Directional Controller handoff
requirements.description: Write the Controller object last and close predecessor routing without inferring retirement.

requirements.title: Project correction lifecycle and history
requirements.description: Maintain project-owned correction effects and complete original history through the existing exact lifecycle transaction.

requirements.title: Correction adoption analysis
requirements.description: Distinguish full, partial, conflicting and unknown adoption without suppressing project authority.

requirements.title: Independent Review in every profile
requirements.description: Every actual independent Review binds and excludes Owner, issuer, writer and all material contributors; quality selection does not weaken independence.

requirements.title: Dynamic role and direct issuance
requirements.description: Keep project-persistent Controller and finite-outcome Owner responsibility separate from temporary actors and direct scoped issuance.

requirements.title: Evidence ceiling discipline
requirements.description: State exactly what tests and observations do and do not prove.

requirements.title: External side effects remain separate
requirements.description: Require a current independent boundary for browser, device and external actions.

requirements.title: Final output completeness
requirements.description: Deliver the accepted current result, evidence ceiling, material limitations and unique next action.

requirements.title: Project backend binding
requirements.description: Resolve the project-selected sealed backend and supported runtime without automatic fallback.

requirements.title: Git planning and disposition boundary
requirements.description: Discussing Git or handing off changed artifacts never grants stage, commit or push authority.

requirements.title: Git and push separation
requirements.description: Keep stage, commit and remote push as separate exact repository actions.

requirements.title: Knowledge impact maintenance
requirements.description: Maintain references only when used or affected, with truthful source responsibility.

requirements.title: Optional Knowledge capability
requirements.description: Keep Knowledge project-local, request-scoped, non-authoritative and explicitly maintained.

requirements.title: Explicit knowledge query
requirements.description: Use explicitly selected non-authority sources and preserve per-entry status and fulltext boundaries.

requirements.title: Direct finite outcome responsibility
requirements.description: Route domain results to their finite outcome owner and recover genuine inflight transitions.

requirements.title: Complete current loading and action rebinding
requirements.description: Load the complete current rule closure once; revalidate unchanged-action scope without assembling bodies. Neither grants authority.

requirements.title: Three-source normative composition
requirements.description: Validate the full effective set, current permission and complete ordered normative units before selection.

requirements.title: Explicit project registration
requirements.description: Register an explicitly adopted qualified source into a safe project, preserving original human authority and finite first work.

requirements.title: Actor-bound project upgrade
requirements.description: Carry exact original and target sources, obligations, admission, projections and recovery through project adoption.

requirements.title: Protected boundary
requirements.description: Protected or excluded paths fail closed and are not accessed through fallback.

requirements.title: Current authority recovery
requirements.description: Use the project Bootstrap to bind current control authority, fixed adopted source and necessary complete rules without granting actions.

requirements.title: Healthy role rebind
requirements.description: Separate owner, actor, role and resource changes from recovery-baseline invalidation.

requirements.title: Owner acceptance remains separate
requirements.description: Keep product/domain acceptance distinct from independent Review and later actions.

requirements.title: Review purpose, qualification and materials
requirements.description: Plan or perform review with current original materials, applicable product requirements and qualified reviewers without inventing a future verdict or automatically demanding independent review.

requirements.title: Review route with actual selected preparation
requirements.description: Route a frozen candidate using selected successful SELF or strict original successful production FINALIZE, without demanding a future verdict.

requirements.title: Disposition of changed deliverables
requirements.description: After owned byte changes, carry pending artifact and Git disposition through later NONE replies until resolved.

requirements.title: Bounded collaboration
requirements.description: Continue safe work without peer waits; new review dispatch uses its own current boundary.

requirements.title: Proportional implementation judgment
requirements.description: For every profile choose a sufficient implementation against accepted outcomes, actual consumers and failure cases; do not replace the requested artifact with analysis.

requirements.title: Task launch and direct route
requirements.description: Choose sufficient legal task organization at real assignment boundaries, with complete direct delegation and healthy reuse.

requirements.title: Bounded domain-owner external action
requirements.description: Permit a bounded domain-local external batch under the current resource grant, including its explicitly permitted named executor, while preserving exception boundaries.

requirements.title: Task resource judgment
requirements.description: Choose sufficient model and effort separately, considering continuing responsibility and total cost.

requirements.title: Task scope closure
requirements.description: Keep the finite outcome, lifecycle, scope, current route, expert consumers and unresolved handoff obligations current.

requirements.title: User decision drift
requirements.description: Reuse a decision only while its material scope, risk and boundary remain frozen.

requirements.title: Mechanical workflow boundary
requirements.description: Validate real workflow transitions against current control authority and observed object context.
